title: Without Delete, New Inventory Part creates only tracked parts
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Staff member {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-NODEL-CREATE) works at {Location-A} with the custom role {Role-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-CREATE-ROLE), which has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and See Financial Data but not 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete'.
  • {User-B} is signed in in a second browser window (for example a private window), and the Admin stays signed in in the first window.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • No part numbered {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NODEL-CREATE-01) exists at {Location-A}; this case creates it with the description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL NO DELETE CREATE).
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab in {User-B}'s window.
custom_steps:
1. In {User-B}'s window click New Inventory Part.
  2. Look at the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click the switch.
  4. Type {Description-A} in Description and {Part-A} in Part Number.
  5. Pick any Category (for example Uncategorized) and type 5.00 in Cost.
  6. Set the Quantity of the {Bin-A} row to 3.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Search {Part-A} and read its Total Qty.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The switch is on and disabled.
  • Step 3: It stays on: {User-B} cannot create an untracked part.
  • Step 7: The dialog closes and the part is saved: creating a tracked part needs only Create & Edit.
  • Step 8: Total Qty reads "3 Available" (a tracked part), not "Not Tracked".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S8-R7, S8-R10, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.1 (New Inventory Part opens) and create-note-6, 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R7: “Creating a part with tracking off requires the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission.”
  • S8-R10: “Creating a tracked part needs only the 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' permission.”
